# ygopro-core embedding wiki

> Source-grounded integration contracts for ygopro-core API 11.0 at 122e0d091a0f399221a4510cc98a406ae485905f, with EDOPro 48ec006c49d7899b39f39420b9a71dea5ecdd22a and Duelcraft JNI host examples. Read only the pages needed for the task. Check source-versions.md before assuming freshness.

## Entry
- [Task router and invariants](README.md): Start here.
- [Source versions](source-versions.md): Evidence, differences, maintenance and scope.
- [Source fingerprints](sources.json): Cited-file SHA-256 values and repository revisions.

## Engine embedding
- [Architecture](architecture.md): Responsibility boundary, internals and source map.
- [Build and compatibility](build-and-compatibility.md): C++17, Lua requirements, linking and upgrades.
- [Core API](core-api.md): All exports, structs, creation errors, pump, ownership and concurrency.
- [Data and scripts](data-and-scripts.md): Database mapping, callbacks, caches and Lua initialization.
- [Rules and coordinates](rules-and-coordinates.md): Teams, zones, deck insertion, flags and reproducibility.

## Binary contracts
- [Protocol](protocol.md): Framing, primitives and message handling.
- [Message index](message-index.md): Public MSG constants with producer/consumer references.
- [Responses](responses.md): Prompt-specific answers, indexes, constraints and retry.
- [Queries](queries.md): Chunk layouts, flags, field snapshots and visibility.

## Host implementations and verification
- [EDOPro host](edopro-host.md): Lifecycle, transport, hidden information, refreshes and replays.
- [Duelcraft JNI](duelcraft-jni.md): Native/Java bridge and local session/network behavior.
- [Integration recipes](integration-recipes.md): Implementation sequence, test matrix and troubleshooting.
